title: Light matter
description: A circular crop opens into a silver still life, trading graphic tension for the full image.
useCase: Let an art, photography or product story move from an intriguing detail to a full composition without changing context.
reducedMotion: The crop changes immediately; keyboard activation also skips the aperture animation.
limitations: Uses original vector artwork, not a photograph. Clip-path animation can require painting; keep the artwork bounded and profile larger adaptations.
look: Brushed-silver spiral ribbon on near-black with a monospace caption and flat grey button; closed, only a central circle shows over pale grey display type.
motion: Pressing the button expands a circular clip-path from 25% to 80% over 850 ms with a strong ease-out, revealing the whole image; closing shrinks it back in 560 ms, interruptibly.
adapt: `reveal` animates `clipPath` with `element.animate` from the computed value to `circle(80% at 50% 46%)` or `circle(25% at 50% 46%)`; tune `duration` and the `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` easing. Replace the SVG artwork in `.sf-aperture-art` and the ghost headline.
